query: Hi, I try buy new phone with my card but payment decline. I have enough money in account. Why it not work? I don’t understand.

Your payment may have been declined for several reasons, even if you have enough money in your account. Here are some steps you can take to troubleshoot the issue:

1. **Check Currency Account**: Ensure that your card is linked to a currency account with sufficient balance. If the card is linked to an account with a low balance, the payment will be declined. You can check this by selecting the card → tapping 'Settings' → 'Spend from'.

2. **Check Pockets**: If your card is linked to a Pocket, make sure that the Pocket has enough balance. You can view your Pocket balance by tapping on 'Accounts' below your balance and going to 'Pockets'.

3. **Review Declined Payment**: From your home screen, open your transactions list by tapping 'See all' below your most recent transactions. Tap the declined payment to see the transaction's details and the reason for the decline in the 'Status' section.

4. **Merchant Issues**: Sometimes, the merchant may have restrictions or technical issues. If you can't find the reason for the decline, consider reaching out to the merchant directly.

5. **Security System**: If our security system flagged the transaction as potential fraud, you may need to complete an in-app questionnaire to review the payment. Check for any notifications in your app regarding this.

If you still need assistance, you can fill out this form to help us reach out to the merchant: [Merchant Support Form](https://app.revolut.com/form/13ef84b4-1e3b-48eb-8e8b-0030e7e08adc?faqEntryPoint=question.why-has-my-card-payment-been-declined).

Once you have the Joint account, you can also split bills with each other without incurring extra fees by using the "Split bill" feature in the app.
